findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_character_set, get_account · Private data: find_animation_guide, create_character_set, get_character_set, export_videos · Public sink: get_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_character_set, get_account · Private data: find_animation_guide, create_character_set, get_character_set, export_videos · Public sink: get_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
